invariants.rationale: Access to fields and methods on 'this' requires that the object is not null at method entry.
'prefRows' is likely an int field and this expresses that it is within the int bounds, which is always true for int.
'style' is dereferenced (style.font, style.background) and must be non-null for method correctness.
'style.font' is accessed for getLineHeight(), so it must be non-null for the method to work properly.
If style.background is present, its heights and minHeight are likely non-negative, as negative layout measurements would be unusual.
